metrics: all 254 population mean rates and single-cell rate distributions
all population sampled LvR: eligible and zero-padded means; eligibility counts
all population sampled mean pairwise correlations and sample counts
all 32 area rates and first/second-half means
all area 1 ms time series; burst/occupancy and spectral methods require separate frozen definitions before hypothesis testing

comparison.diagnostics: Per-population reference values, ranges, sample standard deviations and Rust-baseline position. Two or three references are exploratory; sample range is not a prediction or equivalence interval.
comparison.holdout_rule: Audit full-condition fidelity and define scientifically meaningful metrics/margins using reference evidence before inspecting Rust confirmation realizations. Do not fit margins to known Rust discrepancies.

long_duration_and_performance_acceptance: Open; this pilot does not replace paper-duration/condition validation or tuned speed/cost benchmarks.
